_note: Plan facts follow docs/ai/DECISIONS.md #18 and DATA.md (Free runs, 50 Pro runs, 20 Pay-as-you-go runs). Prices are KRW only, a deliberate owner decision that deviates from #18 (Pro ₩12,000 per month, Pay-as-you-go ₩6,500, Custom ₩130 per run with a ₩12,000 minimum). Amounts are fixed display-only demo values; nothing is ever charged and buying never changes the account. The demo has ONE set of limits for everyone (demo_limits), copied from api/config/limits.toml: max_file_bytes 5 MB, max_rows 20,000, max_pdf_pages 30, daily_runs_per_user 10. The paid cards and the Custom calculator carry no file-size, row or page limits because the server does not enforce any higher ones.
